name: 竖屏短剧剧本
description: 从一句梗概写出竖屏微短剧的开篇集：故事设定和人物 → 分集节拍（黄金三秒、期待-压抑-爆发、付费卡点）→ 逐集剧本 → 按广电总局管理提示和创作标准审读 → 脚本检查集数、时长和钩子。 / Write the opening episodes of a vertical micro-drama from a one-line premise: story bible and characters → episode beats (3-second hook, build-up/suppression/payoff, paywall cliffhanger) → scripts → a read against NRTA guidance and craft standards → script checks on count, length and hooks.

premise.description: 一句话梗概，例如：被裁员的程序员回老家开面馆，前老板来应聘 / One-line premise

genre.description: 类型，例如：都市逆袭、甜宠、悬疑 / Genre, e.g. underdog comeback, romance, mystery

episodes.description: 写前几集。行业常见是一部 80 到 100 集、前 10 到 20 集免费，这里先写开篇 / How many opening episodes to write. A typical series runs 80 to 100 episodes with the first 10 to 20 free

episodeSeconds.description: 每集大约几秒 / About how many seconds per episode

paywallAt.description: 付费卡点放在第几集结尾，0 表示不设 / Which episode ends on the paywall cliffhanger; 0 for none

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 设定和人物
stages.description: 一句话故事、观众要的核心情绪（逆袭、甜宠、复仇、悬疑……）、主角的目标和阻碍，以及 3 到 5 个人物。 / The logline, the core emotion the audience comes for (comeback, romance, revenge, mystery…), the lead's goal and obstacle, and 3 to 5 characters.

stages.name: 分集大纲
stages.description: 每集的前三秒钩子、压抑点、爆发点（爽点或反转）和结尾悬念；付费卡点那一集的悬念最强。 / Each episode's 3-second hook, suppression beat, payoff (twist or win) and cliffhanger; the paywall episode gets the strongest one.

stages.name: 剧本
stages.description: 逐集写镜头、动作和台词，竖屏近景为主，镜头短、台词短。 / Write each episode's shots, action and dialogue: vertical, mostly close-ups, short shots, short lines.

stages.name: 审读
stages.description: 像平台审核和责编一样读一遍：内容导向（广电总局管理提示）和创作质量（钩子、节奏、人物动机），列出要改的地方。 / Read it like a platform reviewer and script editor: content guidance (NRTA notices) and craft (hooks, pacing, motivation), listing what to fix.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 集数对不对、按台词估算的时长、哪个人物没出场、哪集没写结尾悬念。 / Is the episode count right, estimated length from dialogue, characters who never appear, episodes without a cliffhanger.
